findings.issue: Unused imports: readJson, writeJson, STATE_DIR
findings.recommendation: Remove unused destructured imports

findings.issue: Dead code: const files assigned but never used in getTaskDiff()
findings.recommendation: Remove unused variable and unreachable try/catch

findings.issue: Hardcoded 'sonnet' return when hybrid disabled silently downgrades Opus sessions
findings.recommendation: Return null when hybrid disabled to signal no routing override

findings.issue: keyMap keys don't match YAML capability file keys — escalation logic permanently dead
findings.recommendation: Align keyMap with actual YAML keys

findings.issue: Lazy require() inside async hook function body; inconsistent with codebase pattern
findings.recommendation: Move require to top-level imports

findings.issue: completedPhases adds current phase before it finishes — recovery may skip incomplete phases
findings.recommendation: Only add previous phase to completedPhases, not the one just starting

findings.issue: mergeWithLocal() reads _sampleSize from wrong object; community always gets 0.7 weight
findings.recommendation: Pass sampleSize as separate parameter or read from correct object level

findings.issue: Trend comparison returns 'declining' when scores are equal — should return 'stable'
findings.recommendation: Add third branch for equal scores

findings.issue: Non-greedy regex captures smallest JSON fragment; inconsistent with flow-best-of-n.js greedy pattern
findings.recommendation: Use greedy regex to match largest JSON block

findings.issue: markForRecovery() exported but never called anywhere — recovery trigger mechanism missing
findings.recommendation: Implement caller in PostToolUse hook or session-context hook

findings.issue: getVariationStrategy() with n>3 silently returns fewer candidates than requested
findings.recommendation: Add guard or document hard cap of N=3

findings.issue: queuePayload() queues ALL records every time with no deduplication watermark
findings.recommendation: Track lastSyncedAt watermark; add dedup key to uploads

findings.issue: byCapability and totalCost fields declared but never populated — always empty/zero
findings.recommendation: Populate in recordTaskCompletion() or remove dead fields

findings.issue: Fire-and-forget syncUp() in sync function — process may exit before async write completes
findings.recommendation: Make handleSessionEnd async or use sync queue write

findings.issue: firstAttemptPass defaults to true when undefined, inflating pass rates
findings.recommendation: Default to null when data unavailable; filter nulls in calculations

findings.issue: validateTaskId() returns object, not boolean — !validateTaskId() is always false, validation bypassed
findings.recommendation: Change to !validateTaskId(taskId).valid; same bug in flow-eval.js line 52

findings.issue: Path traversal: task.specPath from ready.json used in path.join without validation
findings.recommendation: Add isPathWithinProject() guard before path.join

findings.issue: Git SHA from git log output not validated before use in subsequent git diff commands
findings.recommendation: Validate output matches /^[a-f0-9]{40}$/ before use

findings.issue: Unvalidated timestamp and filePath from stats.json passed to git commands
findings.recommendation: Validate ISO date format; use isPathWithinProject() for file paths

findings.issue: Raw JSON.parse() on LLM output — should use safeJsonParseString() per project pattern
findings.recommendation: Replace JSON.parse() with safeJsonParseString() from flow-utils.js

findings.issue: Numeric/boolean fields pass through even if not in SAFE_FIELDS — future PII leakage risk
findings.recommendation: Deny-by-default: only pass SAFE_FIELDS, strip everything else unconditionally

findings.issue: Auth token in plaintext .workflow/state/auth.json — gitignore status uncertain
findings.recommendation: Ensure in .gitignore; consider OS credential storage

findings.issue: Endpoint URL overridable from user config — could redirect uploads to attacker server
findings.recommendation: Validate endpoint is HTTPS and optionally allowlist trusted domains

findings.issue: Exports don't match spec names: shouldCompactAtPhase vs shouldCompactNow, etc. — callers get undefined
findings.recommendation: Add alias exports or update spec and all callers

findings.issue: syncUp() reads stats.json outside lock while recordTaskCompletion writes under lock — TOCTOU race
findings.recommendation: Wrap loadStats() in syncUp() with withLock()

findings.issue: syncDown() result discarded — context.communityKnowledge never populated, formatter section dead
findings.recommendation: Capture syncDown result or read cached community data after sync

findings.issue: Export names diverge from spec: getModelPerformance vs getModelStats, rotateStats not exported
findings.recommendation: Add alias exports matching spec names

findings.issue: Export names diverge from spec: checkFileRevisions and getRevisionSummary don't exist
findings.recommendation: Add alias exports or update spec

findings.issue: IIFE getAgentModel re-export executes at module load — silent fallback if flow-prompt-template fails
findings.recommendation: Convert to lazy getter for explicit error boundary
